answer: Checking is dull by design: the paint stays fresh, the mark gets checked, the date stays fixed. Honest work runs 31 minutes a proof; the farm needs 236 proofs, which is 7316 minutes it cannot paint. A whisper can be painted, a delta can be borrowed, but a terrace must be lived, and the farm has lived nothing. One proof settles it, and it reads Excise clerk honey mead proof distilled at the excise office, spelled out in full as each honey mead is a cask count weighed beside the makers mark. Honest proof grows from seed; farm proof is sawdust on the workshop floor.
